answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation built from gradual, verified work. Think of a reef: coral accretes layer by layer, and a fake reef cannot be grown overnight. Each agent accrues trust like a walnut tree that only yields after years of growth, while an orchard of freshly planted impostors shows no fruit when peers audit history. Require new identities to burn a small stake, wait through epochs, and earn attestations from long-lived peers before payouts, making mass fake accounts economically pointless.
